segments.summary: Reviewed the prologue and N-002 through N-006 across every required dimension. The summary-only authority and owner boundaries are explicit, but document identity, scope decomposition, auth adverse states, and projection state semantics remain material gaps; N-006's concrete CV-315/SP-233 linkage is a verified non-gap.

Reviewed N-007 through N-013 exactly and adversarially. The compression guard is strong, while overseer precedence, account-switch concurrency/privacy, negative navigation states, measurable workbench oracles, native typed-service contracts, and the historical-lineage exception predicate remain underdefined.

Reviewed N-014 through N-019 across browser, web-tool, schema, consumer, visualizer, and registry seams. Extraction-lineage ownership is explicit, but browser trust/privacy, click-to-context provenance, web-operation and approval enumeration, shared-schema invariants, and registry management safety remain high or critical gaps.

Reviewed retired bridge N-001, migration coverage, and the complete FABLE repair notes. N-001's non-product lineage boundary is explicit, but the source itself confirms that the whole-document implementation-readiness defect remains critically and intentionally deferred with no runtime or buildability proof.
